definition: the science of the earth's rocks and history
description: A rocky beach below a tall cliff of striped red, cream and brown rock layers. A young man in a navy jacket and orange T-shirt kneels on a flat rock and splits a stone open with a hammer, chips of rock flying, then lifts one half and reveals a spiral fossil shell inside. A young woman in a yellow jacket leans in with a small hand lens and stares at it with her mouth open. Two more students measure the cliff layers with a tall pole, and a notebook and backpacks lie nearby, with the sea and a blue sky behind.
